title: Theme of a Quadrava application
description: Design tokens of a theme. The runtime applies them as CSS custom properties (--lc-*). The allowed values are deliberately restricted: a theme cannot inject arbitrary CSS.

label.description: Name of the theme for people, for example in an editor (at most 80 characters). The runtime shell names a theme with the key app.theme. followed by its identifier, in the catalogue.

brand.description: Logo and name of the application: at the top left of the side bar and in the browser tab (title and icons). If absent, the Quadrava logo, title and icons. Images are relative addresses (images/logo.svg, served next to the application), https:// or data:image/…;base64 (svg, png, jpeg, gif, webp, up to about 75 kB): any other address is not shown.

name.description: Name of the application: the title of the browser tab, the accessible name of the logo, and the text next to it with showName or when there is no logo.

logo.description: Image of the logo in the expanded side bar (it usually holds the name too).

logoOnDark.description: Variant of the logo for a dark side bar (sider tone dark); the logo if absent.

icon.description: Square image for the collapsed side bar; without it the collapsed bar shows the logo, reduced.

icons.description: Icons of the browser tab, in place of the Quadrava ones. With icons, a kind that is not given is left out rather than taken from Quadrava.

svg.description: Icon in SVG (any size), used by most browsers.

png32.description: Icon in PNG, 32 x 32 px, for browsers without SVG icons.

appleTouch.description: Icon in PNG, 180 x 180 px, for the home screen of iOS and iPadOS.

showName.description: Shows the name next to the logo (for a logo that is only a symbol).

height.description: Height of the logo in px (32 if absent).

tokens.description: Design tokens of the theme, applied as CSS variables.

colors.description: Base colours; the others derive from them when absent.

primary.description: Colour of buttons, links and the active item of the menu: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

onPrimary.description: Colour of text on the primary colour: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

background.description: Colour of the page behind the components: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

surface.description: Colour of cards, sections and bars: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

onSurface.description: Colour of text: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

mutedText.description: Colour of secondary text (hints, dates); the text colour if absent: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

border.description: Colour of borders and separators: #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

danger.description: Colour of errors and dangerous actions (#c62828 if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

success.description: Colour of positive outcomes (#2e7d32 if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

warning.description: Colour of warnings that do not block (validation warnings, password strength «fair») (#ad6800 if absent). Keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1 with the surface.

typography.description: Font and base size of the text.

fontFamily.description: Font family, as in CSS, for example Inter, system-ui, sans-serif (system-ui, sans-serif if absent).

density.description: Spacing and height of the controls: compact or comfortable (default).

layout.description: Look of the application shell: side bar, top bar, page header, spacing. All optional: if missing, the side bar is light (surface colours) and the measures are those of Ant Design Pro.

sider.description: Side menu. Each colour falls back on the base colours.

tone.description: Style of the menu: light or dark.

background.description: Colour of the side menu (surface if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

text.description: Colour of the items of the menu (the text colour if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

mutedText.description: Colour of the group titles of the menu (mutedText if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

activeBackground.description: Colour of the background of the active item (a light shade of primary if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

activeText.description: Colour of the active item (primary if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

border.description: Colour of the edge of the menu (border if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

header.description: Top bar. Each colour falls back on the base colours.

background.description: Colour of the top bar (surface if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

text.description: Colour of the text of the top bar (the text colour if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

border.description: Colour of the lower edge of the top bar (border if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

pageHeader.description: Header of the screen, with title and breadcrumbs. Each colour falls back on the base colours.

background.description: Colour of the header of the screen (surface if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

text.description: Colour of the title of the screen (the text colour if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

mutedText.description: Colour of the breadcrumbs (mutedText if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

border.description: Colour of the lower edge of the header (border if absent): #rgb, #rrggbb (also with transparency), rgb() or hsl().

content.description: Area of the screen under the header.
